{{Quote|Dutch is gone. He was my friend. He piloted me once to a mission in the Belassar system.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="CtE" />}}
The '''Mission in the Belassar system''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] intended to the suppress [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity in the system.<ref name="TEA-167" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] undertook a mission in the [[Belassar system/Legends|Belassar system]] during the struggle, along with [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jon Vander/Legends|Jon "Dutch" Vander]].<ref name="CtE" /> The princess transmitted messages, dispensed much-needed material, and brought time for the Rebel evacuation.<ref name="TEA-167" />
